description: Model the business domain by extracting and refining domain concepts from  stories in the story-graph
goal: Create a comprehensive domain model from domain concepts captured in story-graph.json - define domain language, responsibilities, and relationships
inputs: story-graph.json missing domain concepts, domain expert interviews, existing domain documentation
instructions: Synthesize context into domain concepts and build a domain model that connect business and solution language

actions.name: clarify
instructions: Gather context for domain modeling - understand business language and domain boundaries

actions.name: strategy
instructions: Make strategic decisions about domain modeling approach and scope

actions.name: build
instructions: Refine domain concept definitions, responsibilities, and relationships
Apply domain shaping rules when defining domain concepts
Use domain shaping rules to guide the creation of the domain model
Update story-graph.json with the new / updated domain concepts and relationships

actions.name: validate
instructions: validate domain model against domain shaping rules
Ensure domain concepts use ubiquitous language
Verify relationships and responsibilities are clear

actions.name: render
instructions: render domain model documents from story-graph.json

actions.name: rules
instructions: Display domain rules for this behavior as AI context

trigger_words.description: Behavior-level trigger words - specific to domain modeling
